task: Predict disease-specific survival in esophageal carcinoma using discretized time bins. Each case is assigned to one of four time bins from early to late with censored or event status; adverse H&E features include poor differentiation, infiltrative growth, necrosis, lymphovascular invasion, and deep wall invasion.

classes.0: Earliest time bin, censored — short follow-up with no disease-specific death recorded.
classes.1: Second time bin, censored — intermediate-short follow-up with no disease-specific death recorded.
classes.2: Third time bin, censored — intermediate-long follow-up with no disease-specific death recorded.
classes.3: Fourth time bin, censored — longest follow-up with no disease-specific death recorded.
classes.4: Earliest time bin, event — disease-specific death occurred early, consistent with highly aggressive tumor morphology.
classes.5: Second time bin, event — disease-specific death occurred at an intermediate-early timepoint.
classes.6: Third time bin, event — disease-specific death occurred at an intermediate-late timepoint.
classes.7: Fourth time bin, event — disease-specific death occurred late after prolonged survival.
